summary: The CLI review passes under the PM round cap. The audit found no real-key leak in the phase diff or a committed public page. Two findings can leave stale public results.
nonblocking_findings: F7 [Nit] review-c: A missing overview template causes a silent, successful commit with a stale overview. preview.sh:435-441 returns the old index, and update.sh:195-219 accepts it. The temp run exited 0 and committed new model-guide.json, but index.html kept the old evidence. One fix round: require a fresh overview on the docs route before the commit. score-impact: yes.

F8 [Nit] review-c: The changed-score path leaves the published score JSON stale even when the review HTML rebuilds. preview.sh:1069-1089 generates both outputs, but update.sh:220-247 takes only the HTML. The temp run published the new fixture route in review.html and left docs/assets/data/review.json byte-identical. One fix round: align the two public score outputs and reconcile the exact commit set in the contract. score-impact: yes.

F9 [Nit] review-c: A commit and a no-op both exit 0 with empty output. update.sh:248-254 prints no paths. README.md:293 requires the run log to name the files pushed. test-strategy.md:207-212 checks the commit paths but does not explicitly put them in the log. Tech debt: distinguish a no-op from a commit and document how to record the actual push set. score-impact: no.

F10 [Nit] review-c: The usage line omits the supported --docs flag. update.sh:49-65 requires it before the manifest. A lone unknown option reaches the manifest check instead of the usage line. Tech debt: show [--docs] before the manifest and reject unsupported options as usage errors. score-impact: no.

F11 [Nit] review-c: README.md:289 names the docs-relative data paths for a preview-only run. update.sh:179-183 writes the two basenames directly under .tmp/model-guide-preview/. Tech debt: name the two actual preview paths. score-impact: no.

F12 [Nit] review-c: The Phase 2 task command works from the repo root. The first line in test-strategy.md:196-199 changes into harness/, so the next line in the same shell exits 127. Tech debt: keep the precheck directory change in a subshell or state that the update starts at the repo root. score-impact: no.

F13 [Nit] review-c: A rerun on a later calendar date can commit without new export or score data. update.sh:162-166 sets --today, and guide.ts:483-491 stores that date in model-guide.json. A temp rerun on the next day committed only that file. Tech debt: clarify when the no-op promise applies. score-impact: no.

F14 [Nit] review-c: publish.ts:49 promises one line per refusal, but publish.ts:220-223 prints one line per drifted path. A temp run printed two drift lines and exited 2. This behavior predates the phase. Tech debt: document the drift exception. score-impact: no.
